content.comment_body: Hello, does [product_name] work with Office 365? Regards, [user_name]
No, it does not. Please refer to the official statement from [company_name] support regarding this. In the Add-in tab, the [product_name] menu does not appear.
Okay, thanks. Is there any information on whether a solution is being developed?

analysis.insight_summary: A user inquired about compatibility between [product_name] and Office 365. The responses clarify that [product_name] is currently unsupported with Office 365, as its integration option is missing from the add-in tab. While users are interested in future support or development, there is no indication of ongoing work or planned updates for compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: [user_name] anticipated that [product_name] would work with Office 365 and offer integration through the add-in interface.
